requirement: SPEC.md section 7, shapes and their derived values
note: Where the corners of a preset fall, what a list of points measures, and what a vertex being added, deleted or inserted does to the slots of a path. A shape carries its slots as an ordered list rather than as a JSON object, because slot order is observable and the two engines read a JSON object into differently ordered maps. The renumbering cases are the reason: a delete takes every vertex slot out and writes the survivors back, so the answer states the new order as well as the new values.
